url.description: Full Wikipedia URL of the building article.

title.description: Name of the building from the Wikipedia article title.

country.description: Country where the building is located, extracted from the infobox.

building_type.description: Functional type or use of the building (e.g. museum, office, residential).

paragraphs.description: First two paragraphs from the Wikipedia article body.

first_image_url.description: URL of the first image found in the Wikipedia article.

img_npy.description: First image stored as an RGB numpy array.
